business_summary: Tobu Railway Co., Ltd. provides private rail system services in Japan. The company operates health clubs, golf courses, theme parks, and hotels. It also develops and manages condominiums, housing developments, department stores, and other properties along its railways. In addition, the company operates sightseeing service center, station information, railroadmap, Wi-Fi, information on unstaffed stations, alternative transportation, and buying pasmo cards and tickets, as well as sightseeing destinations, access information, and special tickets. Further, it is involved in general transportation business by rail, tramway, and cableway; automobile transport business; real estate sales, leases, brokerage, appraisal, and management businesses; information provision and processing services, telecommunications business, and wired broadcasting business; management of entertainment, sports and educational institutions, as well as hotel, food and beverage, retail, travel, advertising and other service businesses; design and construction contracting services for civil engineering, architecture, landscaping, and electrical work; power generation and electricity supply business; businesses incidental to or related to the preceding items. Tobu Railway Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1896 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
